annotations.title: Go back to an earlier web version

description: Puts a site back on a version that was live before (the one before the current, or the one named), at once and with no review: it's how to undo a bad release. Ploa keeps the last 10 versions' files. Tell the person which version it goes back to.

site.description: The site's address (the part before .ploa.app) or ID. Needed when the workspace has more than one site.

version.description: The version's build number (13) or ID, as ploa_web_status lists them.

name: ploa_web_rollback
title: Go back to an earlier web version
